title: 22.20. Saṅkiliṭṭhattika, Hetuduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṁ nahetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā nava …pe… vipāke cha …pe… avigate nava.
